items.title: Identify the theme of the poem
items.explanation: The theme is patriotism and sacrifice. The poem praises soldiers for their bravery in defending borders, highlighting their dedication to the nation even when asleep or during harsh weather conditions.

items.title: Identify the tone of the poem
items.explanation: The tone is admiring and respectful. The poet expresses deep gratitude and reverence for the soldiers' service, using phrases like 'Prime of your youth given to the nation!!' to convey admiration.

items.title: Identify the poetic devices used
items.explanation: The poem uses imagery (deserts, marshes), simile (soldiers likened to yogis), metaphor (wind chimes representing respect), and repetition ('you', 'we') to emphasize unity and shared purpose.
